html.content:
Recommended

Barscore: 1.0

Vertical or horizontal bars comparing values across categories.

Clinical use: AE counts by SOC/arm, subject counts by group

  • 1+ category + 1+ numeric
  • small-medium dataset
  • manageable category count

generate_canvasxpress_config with description='grouped bar chart of <metric> by <category>'

Alternatives

Dotplotscore: 0.85

Individual data points per group — best when n < ~50 per group.

Clinical use: Individual lab values, small Phase I cohorts

  • cat + numeric
  • small n — show every point

generate_canvasxpress_config with description='dot plot of <numeric> by <factor>'

Scatter3Dscore: 0.85

3D scatter for three continuous dimensions.

Clinical use: Multivariate exploratory analysis

  • 3 numeric → x/y/z scatter
  • colour by category

generate_canvasxpress_config with description='3D scatter of <num1> vs <num2> vs <num3>'

Ridgelinescore: 0.85

Stacked density plots per group — compare distributions without overlap.

Clinical use: Lab distributions across multiple visits or arms

  • cat + numeric → stacked densities
  • several groups to compare
  • 4+ groups → ridgeline avoids overlapping color curves

generate_canvasxpress_config with description='ridgeline plot of <numeric> by <factor>'

Scatter2Dscore: 0.8

Points on x/y axes revealing correlation between two numeric variables.

Clinical use: Biomarker vs response, PK/PD, PCA plot by treatment

  • 2+ numeric → x/y scatter
  • colour by category

generate_canvasxpress_config with description='scatter plot of <num1> vs <num2> colored by <factor>'
